Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G4059; uncircumcised (figuratively):--uncircumcised.
BiblicalUsage: Uncircumcised — Stephen's charge to the council: stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, always resisting the Holy Ghost. The word is not about the body; it is about a heart that will not listen.
TheologicalSignificance: I take Stephen's rebuke personally: a heart that will not hear is uncircumcised whatever its outward marks.
